req.title: Echo request headers
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /headers with a JSON object whose 'headers' field mirrors the request headers received.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /headers must return a JSON object with a 'headers' field that mirrors the request headers. I designed tests covering: (1) positive EP — standard custom header is echoed exactly; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — empty/minimal header set still returns valid structure; (4) DT — multiple custom headers all echoed; (5) BVA — header with a single-character name and value at boundary. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with custom header X-Test-Header: hello-world
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: system shall respond with JSON whose 'headers' field mirrors request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'hello-world'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert isinstance(data['headers'], dict)
    assert data['headers']['X-Test-Header'] == 'hello-world'
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type

test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly()

tests.name: test_headers_multiple_custom_headers_all_echoed
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with X-Alpha: alpha-val and X-Beta: beta-val
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: all request headers must be mirrored — decision table covers multiple header combinations
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_multiple_custom_headers_all_echoed():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={
        'X-Alpha': 'alpha-val',
        'X-Beta': 'beta-val'
    })
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    hdrs = data['headers']
    assert hdrs['X-Alpha'] == 'alpha-val'
    assert hdrs['X-Beta'] == 'beta-val'
    assert hdrs['X-Alpha'] != hdrs['X-Beta']

test_headers_multiple_custom_headers_all_echoed()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_single_char_header_value_boundary():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Tiny': 'a'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    val = data['headers']['X-Tiny']
    assert val == 'a'
    assert len(val) == 1
    assert val != ''
    assert val != 'aa'

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_response_structure_no_extra_top_level_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Check': 'present'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    top_keys = set(data.keys())
    assert top_keys == {'headers'}
    assert 'args' not in top_keys
    assert 'url' not in top_keys
    assert 'origin' not in top_keys
    assert data['headers']['X-Check'] == 'present'

test_headers_response_structure_no_extra_top_level_keys()

tests.name: test_headers_header_value_not_mutated
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Header value contains special characters and digits
actions: Parse JSON response and assert exact value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: mirroring means no transformation — exact value must be preserved
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_header_value_not_mutated():
    client = app.test_client()
    expected_val = 'abc-123_XYZ'
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Custom-Value': expected_val})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    actual = data['headers']['X-Custom-Value']
    assert actual == expected_val
    assert actual == 'abc-123_XYZ'
    assert actual != 'abc-123_xyz'
    assert actual != 'ABC-123_XYZ'

test_headers_header_value_not_mutated()
